prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one high-fidelity portrait mobile-first web app screen
Primary request: Design a shippable interactive latte art simulator UI in a mature jet-age airline ticket-wallet visual world. The screen itself is the artwork: a tall narrow 390x844-style smartphone viewport shown edge-to-edge, with no phone hardware or device frame.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed app interface on warm off-white ticket stock, layered with restrained navy panels and subtle perforation, trim, route-line, and carbon-copy details. No photographic scene.
Subject and layout: Compact top bar with the exact brand "LatteArt" at left; the exact language control "繁中 / EN" and a small settings gear icon at right. Below it, make a large round latte canvas the unmistakable central interactive focus, showing realistic cream-and-coffee marbling in progress inside a clean circular cup/work surface. Keep ample touch space around it. In the lower thumb-reach zone, place exactly three immediately available large ticket-stub tool controls in one clear row, labeled exactly "Pour", "Stir", and "Lift", each with a simple professional line icon and a selected-state treatment. Include a smaller exact "Reset" control nearby. Show advanced settings as collapsed through a compact closed drawer/tab using only an icon and chevron, with no label. Include one restrained completion/share stamp control using only a check/share symbol and no words.
Style/medium: realistic high-fidelity product UI mockup, crisp digital interface, practical interaction states, refined editorial typography, precise spacing, strong hierarchy, not concept art and not a poster.
Composition/framing: single continuous portrait screen, edge-to-edge, tall narrow 390:844 aspect impression. Large circular latte canvas dominates the center; tool controls remain immediately reachable near the bottom; nothing cropped.
Color palette: deep navy #142F4C, signal red #E64A35, warm ticket paper #F7F5ED, carbon purple #674568, and very restrained brass #D8B04B accents. Maintain accessible contrast.
Materials/textures: subtle aged ticket-stock fiber, fine red registration marks, navy ink, faint purple carbon-copy shadow, small perforated edges; clean and mature, never distressed enough to hurt legibility.
Text (verbatim, render each exactly and only as listed): "LatteArt", "Pour", "Stir", "Lift", "Reset", "繁中 / EN".
Constraints: This must visibly read as an interactive latte art simulator. Prioritize the latte canvas and the three tool controls. All exact text must be crisp and legible. Use icons without accompanying words for settings, collapsed advanced settings, completion, and share. No extra text, no numbers, no placeholder copy, no invented claims, no slogans, no navigation labels.
Avoid: device frame, hands, people, poster design, photography, coffee-shop scene, boarding-pass mockup detached from UI, emoji, childish colors, cartoon styling, skeuomorphic clutter, tiny illegible decorative copy, pseudo-text, watermark, logos other than the exact LatteArt wordmark.
